title: Bowling Strike
blurb: Ball down the lane, then the clatter of pins going everywhere. A strike compressed into a second and a bit. Bowling alleys keep one of the few genuinely distinctive acoustic signatures left in public life — hard maple, low ceilings and a crash with a long rattling tail. The tail is what makes the clip so useful in edits, because it reads as things collapsing rather than merely pins falling. It works over a knocked-over drink or a plan coming apart. Streamers bind it as a fail alert for that very reason.
origin: A bowling ball striking pins, recorded in a lane.
